newsitem.title: USA: CRSS says changes name to Tractebel Power.
newsitem.headline: CRSS says changes name to Tractebel Power.

text.p: CRSS Inc said Friday it changed its name to Tractebel Power Inc to more closely align itself to its parent company, Tractebel SA.

Bill Utt, president and chief executive of Tractebel Power, said: "The decision to change the company's name was driven by a desire to more closely align the North American independent power project development activities of the former CRSS with the worldwide activities of its parent, Tractebel SA."
Tractebel Power of Houston owns and operates energy facilities in the United States and a cogeneration facility in Ontario, Canada.
Tractebel SA, headquartered in Brussels, is in the natural gas, engineering and electricity generation, transmission and distribution company.
